sources.quote:
A supplier may deliver a part only if the approved supplier list contains an approval for that
supplier, that part, the receiving site and the customer.
the audit qualifies the company. Part approvals stay as they are.

findings.why: The only approval for SUP-C on BR-180 is for Beinasco (PLT-BEI). No approval exists for Pinerolo (PLT-PIN). The 2026-11-06 return to approved status of the supplier does not extend part approvals.

sources.quote: 7.3 Approval is granted per part number and per manufacturing site.
7.2 Aurelia shall be notified of every planned change at least 90 days before implementation.

findings.why: BR-180 belongs to PRG-Z (Aurelia). Revision 4 of the Aurelia manual is in force and replaces revision 3. It requires approval per part and per site, plus 90 days' notice. The only approved site is Beinasco, and no Aurelia approval for Pinerolo is in the documents.
